initial.lightMaterialIdentification: Exact runtime MeshBasicMaterial colors matched to existing factories; no new material factory/cache calls. Missing or occluded ROI is recorded, not treated as a style pass.

cityStats.ownership: Own emitted geometry, far instances and material clones; borrow all station atlases, far facade textures and gradient maps. Dispose before station.
cityStats.limitation: Background only: no new physics or navigable interiors. Foundations and stairs are CPU checked; camera composition and visible CDLOD contacts need GPU acceptance.

initial.method: Actual C11 scene and pinned nine assets. Main RAF frozen/time14; per view select once, AO .55 then0 only. Each state retains one warmup plus two fresh render captures. Current default service preset plus exact saved C8 legacy service world camera for identical HDR ROI comparison. 20/21 formulas and FOV58 match C8 AO experiment. No contrast ABA, UI/physics test, performance claim, source/material/quality/light replacement.

scope: Fixed-time AO on/off views and real runtime asset/material readback; no performance claims from these captures. Legacy C8 camera and recorded raw ROI reference are preserved separately. Loaded materials/renderOk do not by themselves establish visual/style acceptance.
shadowScope: The 18 shadow-flag captures are separate from the original 42 AO captures. Original -> four noncasting Toon bins enabled -> restored is a bounded diagnostic, not a product fix. C10 reference contains two historically observed lamp meshes plus separately labeled whole-city inference from old source; it is not a full historical mesh observation.
